bug_locations: dependency_order: node/dependency construction now includes every referenced node and materializes dependency sets
dependency_order: available-node selection now repeatedly pops the alphabetically smallest available node
dependency_order: cycle handling now raises ValueError instead of returning a partial order
explanation: The original only used mapping keys as nodes, so referenced-only nodes were omitted and dependents could incorrectly appear ready. It also broke out of the loop and returned a partial result when a cycle remained. The fix builds the full node universe from keys plus referenced nodes, computes indegrees and dependents, uses a min-heap to always choose the alphabetically smallest currently available node, and raises ValueError if not all nodes can be emitted.
